name: Tale in Bliss
original_name: 快樂的童話 Tale in Bliss
source:
Princess was rescued from the court by the prince never met before, and they have a wedding. Throughout four chapters they will embrace the joy of happiness, but will also face death and sadness.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公主被素未谋面的王子从宫廷救出，他们举行了婚礼。在这四章中，他们将拥抱幸福的喜悦，但也将面对死亡和悲伤。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
